verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an LLM inference engine with a server mode, so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers KV-cache paging, fragmentation avoidance, or concurrent-request capacity. The memory-related items concern quantization, mmap-based weight loading, and CPU/GPU offload, none of which address the attention KV cache.
